content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fredericksburg

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour and credential thresholds for your background—bachelor's degree holders and non-degree holders have different pathways. Granite PM Academy can clarify which track fits your profile before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course delivered by certified trainers. Attend all sessions synchronously from Fredericksburg or anywhere with internet access. You'll cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios—contact hours are recorded and verified for your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, create your PMI account and submit your PMP application directly to the Project Management Institute. Document your project-management experience, education, and Granite PM Academy training verification. Pay the PMI exam fee and await approval—typically within days—before scheduling your test.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours. Schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE testing center or test from home. Complete the 180-minute, 180-question PMP exam and receive your results immediately upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteering, or professional involvement—PMI requires a set number per renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PMP renewal workshops and PDU-eligible courses to keep your credential current and your expertise sharp.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
